short_description: The rarest serum antibody and the allergy trigger - a single ~190 kDa monomer of two heavy (epsilon) and two light chains with NO hinge region; an extra pair of constant domains (Cε2-Cε4) makes the Fc fold back on itself into an acutely bent conformation, giving the whole molecule a curved, fishhook-like silhouette rather than a flat Y.

labels.en: No hinge region (absent - replaced by the Cε2 domain pair)
labels.de: Keine Gelenkregion (fehlt - ersetzt durch das Cε2-Domänenpaar)

reference.attribution: Jawahar Swaminathan and MSD staff at the European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI), rendered from PDB 4J4P (Drinkwater et al. 2014, Nat. Struct. Mol. Biol. 21:397-404, "Human immunoglobulin E flexes between acutely bent and extended conformations")
